settings.score: terminated, not invalid/truncated, raw reward exactly 1.0

budget_rationale: Executor and model-call limits are unchanged from native-evaluation-v1. The wall-clock cap is a safety bound only, so that assessment overhead cannot be what ends a B/C episode; latency is reported separately.

selection_rule.description: Keep families where screened A completed some but not all eligible resets (1-4 of 5 when none is excluded). If more than max_families qualify, keep those with A success rate closest to 0.5, ties by family name. If fewer than min_families qualify, add 0-success families in name order until min_families. All-success families are never kept: the base agent has no failure to recover from.

analysis.unit: task-reset pair, resample within fixed family
